mapper.select: SELECT u.nickname, u.profile_image, u.profile_source, sp.soldier_type, sp.rank_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN soldier_profile sp ON sp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_withdrawn = FALSE

SELECT CONCAT(b.mission_type, '_', b.grade) AS badge_code FROM user_badge ub JOIN badge b ON b.badge_id = ub.badge_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ub.acquired_at DESC, ub.user_badge_id DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT b.badge_name, b.badge_description, b.mission_type, b.grade, b.required_completion_count AS required_mission_count, CASE WHEN b.mission_type = 'SAFE' THEN COALESCE(ib.safe_count, 0) WHEN b.mission_type = 'AGGRESSIVE' THEN COALESCE(ib.aggressive_count, 0) ELSE 0 END AS mission_completed_count, CASE WHEN b.mission_type = 'SAFE' THEN COALESCE(ib.safe_count, 0) >= b.required_completion_count WHEN b.mission_type = 'AGGRESSIVE' THEN COALESCE(ib.aggressive_count, 0) >= b.required_completion_count ELSE FALSE END AS achieved, ub.acquired_at FROM badge b LEFT JOIN investment_badge ib ON ib.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN user_badge ub ON ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.badge_id = b.badge_id WHERE b.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY FIELD(b.mission_type, 'SAFE', 'AGGRESSIVE'), b.required_completion_count ASC
SELECT initial_preference, badge_tier, safe_grade, aggressive_grade, safe_count AS safe_mission_count, aggressive_count AS aggressive_mission_count FROM investment_badge WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE codef_connection SET status = 'DISCONNECTED', last_sync_error_message = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE codef_institution_connection cic JOIN codef_connection cc ON cc.connection_id = cic.connection_id SET cic.status = 'DISCONNECTED' WHERE cc.user_id = #{userId} AND cic.status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE connected_account ca JOIN codef_connection cc ON cc.connection_id = ca.connection_id SET ca.status = 'DISCONNECTED' WHERE cc.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE users SET is_withdrawn = TRUE, withdrawn_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_withdrawn = FALSE
